source_content.pdf_ref: Giải Thích Ngữ Pháp Tiếng Anh — Chương 15: Relative Clauses

starter.label: Starter
starter.description_vi: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp, distractor rõ.

build_up.label: Build Up
build_up.description_vi: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế hơn, options gần nhau hơn.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.description_vi: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp đồng thời. Distractor gần đúng, sai ở chi tiết nhỏ.
challenge.distractor_strategy: near_correct — sai ở chi tiết nhỏ

starter.stem: The people ___ live in poverty need urgent help.
starter.explanation_long: Who = đại từ quan hệ chỉ người. Which = chỉ vật.

starter.stem: Climate change, ___ affects millions, is a global crisis.
starter.explanation_long: Which = sự việc (climate change). Non-defining relative clause.

starter.stem: This is the city ___ the international summit was held.
starter.explanation_long: Where = in which. Chỉ nơi chốn.

starter.stem: The country ___ economy depends on tourism is struggling.
starter.explanation_long: Whose = sở hữu. 'Whose economy' = nền kinh tế của quốc gia đó.

starter.stem: The policies ___ the government introduced have been effective.
starter.explanation_short: Defining clause + vật → that hoặc which.
starter.explanation_long: That = defining relative clause. Dùng cho cả người và vật.

starter.stem: Children ___ don't have access to education face many challenges.
starter.ielts_tip: who + V = người làm hành động.

starter.stem: Poverty, ___ is a complex issue, requires a multifaceted approach.
starter.explanation_short: Poverty = sự việc + dấu phẩy → which (non-defining).
starter.explanation_long: Non-defining clause (có dấu phẩy) + vật → which. Không dùng that.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: who (người), that (không dùng trong non-defining)

starter.stem: The regions ___ conflicts occur often suffer from famine.
starter.explanation_long: Where = in which. Chỉ nơi chốn (regions).

starter.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The refugees which fled the conflict need humanitarian aid.'
starter.ielts_tip: who cho người. which cho vật.

starter.stem: 2015 was the year ___ the Paris Agreement was signed.
starter.explanation_long: When = in which (thời gian). '2015 was the year when...'

build_up.stem: People ___ are affected by poverty often lack access to basic healthcare.
build_up.explanation_long: who = chỉ người, đóng vai trò chủ ngữ.
build_up.ielts_tip: who + V = người thực hiện hành động.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: whom (object, sai ở đây vì cần subject)

build_up.stem: The diplomat ___ they appointed negotiated the peace treaty.
build_up.explanation_long: Whom = object. 'They appointed whom' = they appointed him/her.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: who (subject form, nhưng ở đây cần object)

build_up.stem: Global warming, ___ scientists have warned about for decades, continues to worsen.
build_up.explanation_long: Non-defining relative clause (có dấu phẩy) → dùng which, KHÔNG dùng that.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: that (defining OK, nhưng non-defining → sai)

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'Organizations which help refugees provide essential services to people in need.'
options: không có lỗi (that/which dùng cho organizations = đúng)
build_up.correct_answer: Câu đúng, không có lỗi (that/which dùng cho organizations = đúng)
build_up.explanation_short: Organizations = vật (tổ chức, không phải người) → which đúng.
build_up.explanation_long: Organizations = things → which đúng. Mặc dù organizations gồm người, nhưng ngữ pháp treats organizations as things.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: option B bẫy vì nghĩ organizations = people

build_up.stem: Countries ___ natural resources are limited often depend on foreign aid.
build_up.explanation_short: Sở hữu (natural resources of countries) → whose.
build_up.explanation_long: Whose = possession. 'Whose natural resources' = tài nguyên của quốc gia.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The UN, that was founded in 1945, plays a crucial role in maintaining global peace.'
options: Sai: that → which (non-defining clause dùng which)
build_up.correct_answer: Sai: that → which (non-defining clause dùng which)
build_up.explanation_short: Non-defining (dấu phẩy + tên riêng) → which, KHÔNG that.
build_up.explanation_long: Non-defining clause: , which (không , that). The UN = proper noun → non-defining.
build_up.ielts_tip: Non-defining clause KHÔNG bao giờ dùng that.

build_up.stem: Developing regions ___ healthcare is scarce face higher mortality rates.
build_up.explanation_long: Where = in which. Chỉ nơi chốn.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: which (cũng đúng: 'in which healthcare is scarce')

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'Millions of people which lack clean water are at risk of waterborne diseases.'
The treaty, ___ was signed by 195 countries, aims to limit global warming.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: that (defining OK nhưng non-defining → sai)

build_up.stem: The community ___ children cannot attend school is in desperate need of educational funding.
build_up.explanation_short: Sở hữu (children of the community) → whose.
build_up.explanation_long: whose + noun = sở hữu. 'Whose children' = con em của cộng đồng.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: where (nơi chốn, sai ở đây)

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Climate change, that is caused by greenhouse gas emissions, threatens the livelihoods of millions of people worldwide.'
options: that is caused by greenhouse gas emissions
challenge.correct_answer: that is caused by greenhouse gas emissions
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: Non-defining clause (dấu phẩy + proper noun/known entity) → which (không that). Lớp 2: 'Climate change, WHICH is caused by...' = đúng.

options: need better access to education and healthcare.
challenge.correct_answer: People who live in poverty, which is a widespread issue, need better access to education and healthcare.
challenge.explanation_short: who cho people + which cho poverty (non-defining) = chuẩn.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'People who' = người → who. Lớp 2: ', which is a widespread issue' = non-defining cho poverty → which. Lớp 3: Option B dùng 'that' trong non-defining. Option C dùng 'which' cho people.
challenge.feedback_wrong: who cho người. which cho non-defining vật/ý.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A cũng đúng nhưng kém chi tiết

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The activists who the government arrested were fighting for human rights in regions where injustice prevails.'
options: The activists who the government arrested
challenge.correct_answer: The activists who the government arrested
challenge.explanation_short: Object → whom: whom the government arrested.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'the government arrested THEM' → object → whom (không who). Lớp 2: 'where injustice prevails' = đúng. Formal: whom > who khi là object.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 Object → whom: whom the government arrested!
challenge.ielts_tip: Formal: whom cho object. Informal: who OK.

challenge.stem: Chọn câu ĐÚNG NHẤT cho academic writing:
options: The countries that are most affected by climate change are often those which lack the resources to adapt.
The countries most affected by climate change are often those lacking the resources to adapt.
The countries who are most affected by climate change are often those that lack resources.
Countries that climate change affects most are often those who lack resources.
challenge.correct_answer: The countries most affected by climate change are often those lacking the resources to adapt.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'most affected' = reduced relative (= that are most affected). Lớp 2: 'those lacking' = reduced (= those that lack). Lớp 3: Academic ưu tiên reduced clauses → concise.
challenge.feedback_wrong: Reduced: V-ed/V-ing thay cho relative clause.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A cũng đúng nhưng verbose

challenge.stem:
Câu nào ĐÚNG HOÀN TOÀN?
'The organizations ___ [A] provide aid to regions ___ [B] are affected by drought rely on donations from people ___ [C] care about global issues.'
challenge.explanation_short: Organizations = vật → which/that. Regions = vật → that. People = người → who.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: [A] organizations = things → which/that. Lớp 2: [B] regions (vật) + defining → that. Lớp 3: [C] people = người → who.
challenge.feedback_wrong: organizations → which/that. regions → that. people → who.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D (that cho tất cả) đúng nhưng kém chính xác

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The nation who's economy collapsed due to corruption has been struggling to recover for decades.'
challenge.explanation_short: who's = who is. Cần whose (sở hữu): whose economy.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'who's' = 'who is' → sai. Cần 'whose' = sở hữu. Lớp 2: 'whose economy' = nền kinh tế của quốc gia.
challenge.ielts_tip: whose vs who's: whose = sở hữu.

challenge.stem: Chọn câu body paragraph Task 2 CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: should be accessible to all children
regardless of the country in which they live.
should be accessible to all children.
Education which is a fundamental right should be accessible to all.
should be accessible to children where they live.
challenge.correct_answer: Education, which is a fundamental right, should be accessible to all children, regardless of the country in which they live.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: ', which is a fundamental right,' = non-defining clause chuẩn. Lớp 2: 'in which they live' = formal relative clause. Lớp 3: Option B dùng 'that' trong non-defining. Option C thiếu dấu phẩy.
challenge.ielts_tip: in which / for which / by which = formal relative.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B (that trong non-defining) = sai

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Children which grow up in conflict zones often lack education, which limits their opportunities in life.'
options: in conflict zones often lack education
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'Children which' → 'Children who' (người → who). Lớp 2: ', which limits' = non-defining cho education → đúng.
challenge.feedback_wrong: who cho người. which cho vật/ý.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C (, which limits) đúng (non-defining)

challenge.stem: Speaking Part 3: 'Tại sao giáo dục quan trọng?' — Chọn câu CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: Education is important for people who want to improve their lives and contribute to the society where they live.
Education is important for people which want to improve their lives.
Education that people receive helps them in life.
Education is important because it helps people who wants to improve.
challenge.correct_answer: Education is important for people who want to improve their lives and contribute to the society where they live.
challenge.explanation_short: who (người) + where (nơi chốn) = đúng + chi tiết.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'people who want' = người → who. Lớp 2: 'society where they live' = nơi → where. Lớp 3: Option B 'people which' = sai (which cho người). Option D 'who wants' = sai (who + V bare plural).
challenge.feedback_wrong: who cho người. where cho nơi chốn.
challenge.ielts_tip: Speaking: who + where = thêm chi tiết tự nhiên.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D (who wants) sai subject-verb agreement

challenge.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn Task 2 có BAO NHIÊU phrase chứa lỗi?
'The UN, [A] that was established to maintain peace, helps countries [B] who's economies are struggling, particularly in regions [C] which conflicts have displaced millions.'
challenge.explanation_short: [A] that → which (non-defining). [B] who's → whose (sở hữu). [C] which → where (nơi chốn).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: [A] Non-defining clause → which (không that). Lớp 2: [B] 'who's' = 'who is' → cần 'whose' (sở hữu). Lớp 3: [C] 'regions which conflicts' → 'regions where conflicts' (nơi chốn → where).
challenge.feedback_wrong: [A] non-defining: which. [B] sở hữu: whose. [C] nơi: where.
challenge.ielts_tip: Non-defining: which. Possession: whose. Place: where.
